findings.summary: Fixture is documentation, not coverage: it pins no behaviour that another fixture does not already pin. Accepted as advised, recorded in the commit body as documentation.
findings.failure_scenario: Deleting the single-line class-body handling in scripts/java_tests.py's brace walk (or collapsing it to the multi-line path) leaves all 19 tests green, because nested-classes.java and disabled-and-overloads.java already constrain the same counter state. The fixture executes the path without constraining it.
